_comment: What a PermissionRequest hook prints on stdout, as verified by a REAL `claude -p` run (Claude Code 2.1.308, 2026-10-27): a hook printing `allow` made the Bash call run (the marker file appeared); a hook printing `deny` + message blocked the call, and the model quoted the message back verbatim. A hook printing nothing falls through to the normal permission flow. The two input fixtures next to this file are captured payloads with paths replaced.
